Subject: Post-call: Dedicated capacity sizing & SLO confirmation for LumenCloud

Hi Alice / Ben —

Thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap and the asks we promised to follow up on so we can size a Dedicated pilot that validates your performance SLOs. Please confirm or correct any gaps below.

What we heard from the discovery call:
- Primary model: fine-tuned Llama-2-70B (FP16/8-bit quantization planned)
- Typical response length: median 220 tokens, peak up to ~1,200 tokens (rare)
- Target SLOs: p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 300ms for streaming end-to-end (first token latency target 80ms) — confirm if these are strict or negotiable
- Expected steady-state QPS: 150 requests/sec (mixture of short and long responses); peak burst up to 400 qps for short-text flows
- Concurrency requirement: effectively ~60 concurrent active connections (streaming enabled)
- Availability/uptime expectation: enterprise SLA (we'll include Dedicated SLA options)

Attachments: I attached an initial sizing workbook (dedicated_sizing-v2.xlsx) with two candidate configurations and rough monthly reserved throughput estimates.

Immediate asks for LumenCloud to confirm:
1) Are the SLO numbers above accurate (p50/p95/first-token)?
2) Can you share a 48-hour sample of request size distribution and synthetic qps timeline (CSV is fine) — I attached a template lumencloud_load_profile.csv you can fill in.
3) Any constraints on GPU types (preference for H100 vs A100 vs cheaper Ampere alternatives)?
4) Procurement timeline and DocuSign owner so we can align the pilot quote.

Next steps (our side):
- We'll run a quick feasibility run (internal perf lab) to sanity-check whether a 150 qps steady-state target with the stated p95 is reachable with a 2–3 cluster options (H100-heavy, mixed H100/A100, and A100-only).
- Follow up with a recommended Dedicated pilot config + pilot plan + estimated committed monthly cost.

Propose a 30-minute follow-up on Wed to review the sizing options once we get your load profile — does 10:00am PT work for you?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz

Hi Vanessa — thanks for the clear recap. Confirmations below and a couple clarifications:

Confirmations:
- Model: yes, Llama-2-70B fine-tuned (we can run a short representative suite for you)
- Response profile: median ~200–250 tokens; tail to 1k–1.2k tokens for some transcripts
- SLOs: p50 target is soft (we care more about p95). Our business requirement is p95 <= 350ms end-to-end for up to 512-token responses. First-token latency target (for streaming start) preferable < 100ms.
- Steady-state QPS: 150 qps typical; burst up to 400 qps for short interactions during peak marketing events.
- Concurrency: planning for ~60 sustained concurrent streams, spiking to ~180 for short bursts.

Clarifications / asks:
- Streaming: yes, streaming responses are required for at least the short-text flows (the longer transcripts can be returned as non-streamed).
- GPU preference: we don't have a hard requirement but want to see cost/perf trade-offs. Procurement will favor a price-efficient configuration that still meets the p95 requirement.
- Timeline: procurement aims to finalize pilot in ~3 weeks; legal/procurement will want a pilot MSA and estimated committed throughput.

I'll upload a sample 48-hour request profile to the template you included by EOD. Procurement contact is procure@lumencloud.com (cc'd).

Thanks — Alice

Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing options (initial engineering recommendation)

Hi team — quick engineering recommendation based on the stated profile. I ran a light internal run in our perf lab with a representative quantized Llama-2-70B config (8-bit quant; KV cache enabled). Results below are estimates for 512-token median path (streaming early-token overhead included).

Option A — Performance-first (H100-heavy)
- Node config: 8 x H100-80GB (NvLink cluster)
- Reserved throughput: ~420 short-request qps peak, steady 160 qps w/ headroom
- Expected latency (512 tokens): p50 ~90–110ms, p95 ~240–320ms (depends on streaming chunk size)
- Notes: best chance of hitting p95 <= 300ms margin; highest monthly cost.

Option B — Balanced (H100 + A100 mix)
- Node config: 4 x H100 + 8 x A100 (balanced routing for cost/latency)
- Reserved throughput: ~380 qps peak, steady 150 qps
- Expected latency (512 tokens): p50 ~110–140ms, p95 ~300–360ms
- Notes: ~10–20% lower cost vs A, small risk at peak bursts without autoscale buffer.

Option C — Cost-efficient (A100-only)
- Node config: 12 x A100-80GB
- Reserved throughput: ~320 qps peak, steady 120–140 qps
- Expected latency (512 tokens): p50 ~130–160ms, p95 ~340–460ms
- Notes: lowest cost, higher risk on p95 for 512 tokens at full burst. Not recommended if p95 is non-negotiable.

Operational caveats and assumptions:
- Streaming overhead: measured first-token start adds ~40–80ms depending on chunk size and connection warm-up — optimizing chunking and client buffering reduces end-to-end p95 risk.
- KV/prefix caching: we assumed a 20% prefix cache hit rate for chat flows; higher cache hit reduces GPU load and improves p95 significantly.
- Autoscale: Dedicated pilot can include short burstable capacity (on-demand spots) for marketing events; we can size with a small burst pool to avoid paying for sustained reserved capacity.

I'll convert these numbers into the workbook and include cost bands for committed monthly pricing. If Alice can confirm the 48h load CSV, we'll run a targeted sizing sim and come back with a recommended pilot node mix for a 2-week validation test.

-Karthik

Subject: Next steps: Pilot plan & quote for Dedicated validation run

Alice / Ben / Procurement —

Thanks for the quick replies and for uploading the 48-hour profile (we reviewed it). Based on Karthik's engineering options above, here's the proposed path forward so procurement/legal have what they need to approve a pilot: 

1) Pilot scope (2 weeks):
- Configuration: start with Option B (4x H100 + 8x A100) as the balanced baseline; include a 10% burst buffer of on-demand capacity for up to two 1-hour marketing spikes.
- Validation targets: p95 <= 350ms for up to 512-token responses; first-token <= 100ms for streaming start; sustain 150 qps steady with verified peak handling up to 400 qps for short flows.
- Tests: we will run a 72-hour load validation with traffic replay and focused spike tests; we will run end-to-end streaming checks and KV cache tuning.

2) Pricing & procurement:
- Estimated committed monthly price band for Option B (pilot pro-rated for 2 weeks): see dedicated_sizing-v2.xlsx (sheet: pricing). We will prepare a pilot MSA and an optional follow-on commitment schedule if the pilot passes.

3) Action items:
- LumenCloud (procure@lumencloud.com): confirm pilot approval and DocuSign recipient for MSA by Fri, 05 Mar.
- LumenCloud (Alice): confirm streaming chunk sizes (we saw varied chunking in the profile) — this affects first-token latency.
- Redwood (Karthik / Aditya): finalize workbook with exact node counts, autoscale buffer settings, and pilot runbook.

Can we lock the pilot start for Mon, 15 Mar if procurement signs by next week? I'm happy to jump on a 30-minute final scoping call to walk the pilot MSA and runbook — propose Fri 05 Mar 11:00am PT or Mon 08 Mar 09:00am PT.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting the validation run scheduled.

Best,
